arguments.command:
cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/tmp python3 - <<'PY'
from tools import *
import random,json
random.seed(3)
N=4096;E=16384;R=2048;G=512
states=[f'S{i:04d}' for i in range(N)]
En={'name':'E','kind':'enum','values':states};Str={'name':'S','kind':'string','maxsize':0};B={'name':'B','kind':'bool'}
trans=[];seen=set()
for i in range(G):
 fr=0;cmd='g'+str(i);seen.add((fr,cmd));to=random.randrange(N)
 trans.append({'from':states[fr],'to':states[to],'command':cmd,'cost':random.randint(1,65535),'when':['eq',['var','state'],['const','E',states[i]]]})
while len(trans)<E:
 fr=random.randrange(N);cmd='c'+str(random.randrange(1000000))
 if (fr,cmd) in seen: continue
 seen.add((fr,cmd));trans.append({'from':states[fr],'to':random.randrange(N),'command':cmd,'cost':random.randint(1,65535),'when':None})
machine={'states':states,'initial':states[0],'state_param':'state','message_param':'message','transitions':trans}
mods=[{'name':'e','params':[['state','E'],['message','Str']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':None}]
runs=[]
for i in range(R):
 ti=1+(i%G)
 objs={'x0':ti.to_bytes(4,'little'),'x2':b'\0'}
 runs.append({'entry':'e','ktest':ktest(objs)})
camp=base(types=[En,Str,B],modules=mods,entries=['e'],machine=machine,runs=runs)
data=json.dumps(camp,separators=(',',':')).encode();print('size',len(data)/1e6)
open('/workspace/tmp/big2.json','wb').write(data)
PY

PY
